judgment: Accept the local synthetic conversation increment, with crowded-composer and disclosure-affordance reservations.

strengths: Original light/dark desktop and narrow pixels retain the mature assistant-ui reading column, restrained sidebar, legible bilingual typography and coherent composer. Wrapped filename-only chips and an explicit total/count boundary make attachment presence clearer than truncation alone.

The actual deliberate partial failure could be retried to the complete seven-theme response. In a wheel-driven test, reading position stayed at 26px as answer text grew from 1139 to 3211 characters; Return to latest reached the bottom. The stopped response text stayed exactly unchanged over the next second.
Focusing the long filename disclosed its complete name and the contents-not-read boundary for a 1.6-second observation. Escape hid the tooltip while retaining focus on the same filename.

In both live light English and dark Chinese, eight filenames plus forty mixed-language lines stayed bounded. Keyboard End scrolled the attachment region from 0 to 106px at 1280×600 and to 268px at 390×844; removal returned focus to the composer and retained seven files. Document width stayed 390px.

Source inspection found the local deterministic adapter's explicit disclosure, seven-theme response, per-query failure fixture and abort checks intact. Served index hashes matched the disposable-copy index while the owned server process remained alive.
defects: The crowded compact composer is 350px high in a 600px viewport, leaving about 162px above it below the 64px header for answer reading. Bounded scrolling prevents growth from consuming the entire workspace, but reading is cramped in this extreme condition.
Filename disclosure lives on a focusable generic div with a small text chip; it is less explicit as an action than a labeled details button. Long names remain truncated until focused or hovered.
The attachment count/privacy footer and filename metadata are small, subdued text; the stronger answer typography carries most visual emphasis.
unknowns: No screen-reader, touch-discoverability or software-keyboard occlusion study. Normal-speed animation, complete message edit/branch navigation and all error episodes in dark mode remain unassessed.
The full source-selection research and exact new chip-extraction identity were not audited; retained source comments/notices and actual family coherence are distinct evidence.

judgment: Accept the local editorial wiki workspace with table-scroll discoverability and dense-editor reservations.

strengths: Personally viewed originals show a coherent adopted paper direction: warm material around the reading river, paper/red-margin treatment, strong serif English/Chinese hierarchy, subdued tags and differentiated ruled monospaced editing. Both declared themes preserve the long interview and native controls; the source MIT notice and theme configuration are retained.

English and Chinese additions made through the native editor survived reload and appeared in this disposable copy's actual interview tiddler file. Confirmed discard preserved the saved note; the temporary cancelled marker was absent on a later return.
Search-result keyboard activation reached another note's editor. A separate keyboard activation of the ledger's interview link returned to the interview with both saved additions present.

The narrow ledger uses a named, focusable Evidence ledger table region. In light/normal-motion and dark/reduced-motion conditions, ArrowRight moved its contained scroll from 0 to 165px to expose the final evidence-boundary column while the document remained390px wide at horizontal position0.

The started Node server's PID, disposable cwd, rendered theme and writes into that copy establish the exercised source identity. The vendored TiddlyWiki entrypoint matches the supplied foundation byte for byte.
defects: At the initial narrow table position, the rightmost column is clipped and the horizontal scrolling affordance is not obvious until focus/interaction. Keyboard access worked, so this is a discoverability reservation rather than lost data.
The long native editor toolbar occupies several rows at 390px, and ruled monospaced editing is materially denser than reading. Small dim metadata in dark mode is less prominent than note content.
Closing a draft is asynchronous: a very early frame list still contained the departing draft; subsequent navigation and explicit return confirmed that it was removed.
unknowns: No server-outage recovery, broad assistive-technology or natural-speed animation study. The standard palette tiddler was used as a condition fixture in a disposable copy; the full control-panel theme-selection journey was not exercised.
Producer candidate-research evidence is withheld, so this is product/source-family acceptance, not certification of the complete research process.
